LSO.note: Document states nothing on AI harms rules.
The only AI tool named is an agriculture advisory chatbot, which belongs to the sectoral study.

facts.fact: Minister Nthati Moorosi said the Ministry of Communications is developing an AI-powered chatbot for farmers' agricultural information and advice with the Ministry of Agriculture, Food Security and Nutrition.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communications and Ministry of Agriculture

facts.fact: Minister Moorosi said efforts are ongoing to upgrade the High-Performance Computing infrastructure at the Mohale's Hoek Data Centre to support research, analytics and locally relevant AI applications.

LSO.note: Mohale's Hoek Data Centre is named but not stated to rent to others.
The chatbot is still being developed; no system stated as run or live by government staff.
No ownership or for-hire service stated for any data centre.
